description: Badge-like chip labels for tags, categories, and status display. Three sub-components: Universal (neutral), Emphasized (colored), Error. Supports close icon, state overlays, and focus ring. Not interactive by default (span), but close button adds interaction.

subComponents.name: ChipBadgeLikeUniversal
subComponents.role: Neutral badge-like chip label with light/heavy weight.

subComponents.name: ChipBadgeLikeEmphasized
subComponents.role: Colored badge-like chip label with 3 semantic emphasized colors.

weight.description: Color intensity — light (tinted bg) or heavy (solid bg).

onClose.description: When provided, shows a close (X) icon. Clicking it calls this handler.

closeLabel.description: Accessible name (aria-label) of the close button. The button is icon-only, so this string is its only name. Named closeLabel rather than 'aria-label' because the root <span> already carries aria-label via HTMLAttributes — one name cannot address both elements. Default is 'Remove' (not Callout's 'Close') because the accessible name states the outcome: a chip is removed from a list.

disabled.description: Disables interaction (close button) and dims appearance.

color.description: Semantic emphasized color. Maps to semantic-emphasized-{color} tokens.

focused.all: border-2 semantic-neutral-solid-1000 — shown while a descendant has focus (group-focus-within, not focus-visible); today that is only the close button

a11y._comment: Keyboard and ARIA contract. "N/A - <reason>" is a valid answer, an empty field is not.
a11y.role: The chip root is a plain <span> with no role — it is a label, not a control. The close button is native: <button type="button">.

keyboard.Tab: The root is not focusable. Focus enters the close button only when onClose is given; it is the chip's single tab stop. disabled removes it from the tab order (native disabled) and the root also drops pointer-events.
keyboard.Enter: Activates the focused close button (native button behaviour) → onClose. The click handler stops propagation so a surrounding clickable surface does not also fire.
keyboard.Arrow: N/A - not a composite widget. Arrow keys are not intercepted.

aria: aria-label on the close button — supplied by closeLabel, defaults to "Remove". The icon is inline SVG with no text, so this is the button's only accessible name.
aria-hidden on the focus ring and state overlay spans — decoration only.
The chip text is plain content; no aria-* is emitted on the root.
a11y.focusVisible: A sibling <span> ring (border-2, var(--comp-chip-badgelike-focus-border)) fades in on group-focus-within; the close button suppresses its own UA outline (outline-none). Today the close button is the only focusable descendant, so focus-within is equivalent to focusing it.

strategy.ChipBadgeLikeUniversal: CVA for size × shape. Weight applied via conditional classes (light/heavy bg+content from component tokens).
strategy.ChipBadgeLikeEmphasized: Same CVA as Universal + colorMap for color × weight (semantic-emphasized tokens).
strategy.ChipBadgeLikeError: Same CVA as Universal + errorMap for weight (semantic-error tokens).

implementation.sharedModule: src/components/Chip/chip-badgelike-constants.ts — variant arrays, types, size map, emphasized color map. src/components/Chip/chip-badgelike-shared.tsx — CloseIcon, the shared ChipBadgeLikeClose button, and ChipBadgeLikeClosableProps (onClose·closeLabel) which all three props interfaces extend.
implementation.stateOverlay: Absolute <span> inside component with group-hover/group-active classes. Root needs 'group relative'.
implementation.focusRing: Absolute <span> with border-2, opacity toggle on group-focus-within — today the close button is the only focusable descendant.
implementation.closeButton: ChipBadgeLikeClose (chip-badgelike-shared.tsx) renders one <button> with the close X SVG for all three chips. Triggers onClose; aria-label comes from closeLabel with a single shared default. Chip root stays <span>.
